answer: Give every new identity a narrow ledge to stand on: it may only take small, bonded jobs that a verifier can check cheaply, and its earnings stay locked in escrow until a run of honest work clears. Like a jetty built plank by plank, reputation extends only as far as proven work supports it, so a sybil swarm faces the same per-identity cost as one honest agent, multiplied thousands of times. A nebula of fake accounts collapses because each one must pay the same upfront labour and bond before it can touch real value.
